_readme: CANONICAL GEOGRAPHY FOR THE CROVIA PILOT. Single source of truth.
Both the Expo app (src/geo/index.ts) and the FastAPI backend read THIS file.
Do not duplicate coordinates anywhere else.
District and landmark anchors were verified against OpenStreetMap via
Nominatim rather than placed by eye. Zone centres are still positioned by
hand relative to those anchors, so nudge them against the basemap.
Tier 1 districts drive Congestion Insights + coarse geofencing. Tier 2 zones
drive bottleneck geofencing (400-500 m, the practical floor before cell-level
accuracy turns them into noise). Tier 3 clusters are NOT defined here - they
are discovered at runtime by clustering Location Retrieval fixes.
NOTE ON DISTRICT SIZE: Lusail's built core is compact - the stadium, the
Boulevard and the tram are all inside ~1.1 km of each other. Districts here
are therefore 800-1200 m rather than the 1-2 km that a sprawling city would
allow, and neighbouring districts overlap slightly at the edges. That is a
real constraint of the pilot city, not an oversight: attributing a congestion
reading to a district is correspondingly less certain where two districts
overlap, and the agent should treat those margins as lower confidence.

districts.label: Stadium Precinct
districts.notes: Stadium, Boulevard and tram terminus all sit inside this one district because they are within ~1.1 km of each other. Match-day egress is the pilot's primary crowd driver.

districts.label: Fox Hills
districts.notes: Residential towers north-east of the stadium. Absorbs pedestrian overflow on foot.

districts.label: Lusail Central
districts.notes: Commercial core. Steady all-day density rather than event spikes.

districts.label: Marina Waterfront
districts.notes: Waterfront dining and promenade well south of the stadium. Sustained evening density, not spiky.

zones.label: Stadium north concourse
zones.notes: Primary egress fan out of the stadium. Highest crush risk in the pilot.

zones.label: Boulevard south entry
zones.notes: Narrow entry onto Lusail Boulevard. Accumulates once the promenade is full.

zones.label: Stadium tram link
zones.notes: Lusail Tram terminus. Funnels stadium egress onto rail; platform capacity is the constraint.

zones.label: Fox Hills crossing
zones.notes: Signalised crossing on the walking route out of the precinct. Pedestrians pool between phases.

zones.label: Central plaza crossing
zones.notes: Main pedestrian crossing in the commercial core.

zones.label: Marina promenade
zones.notes: Waterfront walk. Water on one side means egress is single-sided.
